activation_policy: Actual post-contract-commit clock in a separate append-only activation receipt; prepared_utc does not activate.

evaluation_protocol.entry_rule: First observed valid quote with BOTH market and successor availability strictly after independent forecast/receipt consumption.
evaluation_protocol.graduation: None. Overlapping research outcomes and caller-observed clocks are not independent evidence or order authorization.
evaluation_protocol.missingness: Retain all attempts, abstentions, missing publication/entries/targets and both local families; no return-based selection.
evaluation_protocol.target_rule: Original reference market epoch plus3600, never shifted by fitting/publication/entry.
evaluation_protocol.window_semantics: Export replaces these placeholders with actual registered activation and consistent snapshot cutoff.

execution_scope: No broker API, signal-feed write, lifecycle/promotion or order capability; no activation of sourceV9/rankV8.
historical_training_scope: Retained past candles may train a newly issued future forecast. No historical forecasts or historical first-known clocks are imported.

input_policy.availability: conservative observed clock after stable source read; training computation completed before issuance
input_policy.gap_policy: Require 61 consecutive EURUSD closes; ridge training uses complete real 121-price windows with exact H1 labels; EWMA resets at the latest EURUSD gap. No peer inputs, imputation or compressed timestamps.

model_identity_scope: Source, fixed parameters, exact captured inputs and dependency versions; no claim that fitted weights are stored.
operational_revision: Separate local-model comparison: EURUSD ridge and EWMA use only their own required observations. Other pairs cannot withhold these forecasts. The gap_v2 four-family cohort remains separate and active; no partial batches or duplicate model stand-ins are imported.
